title: Hatsune Miku — Shiny Smiley Magic〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, let's decide on which show we're gonna do to show our support for Tsukasa and the others☆

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They all seem very excited about this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, they do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Now, let's start with some general ideas. Any suggestions?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, I do♪
We should do a show they've done before☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: One they've done before?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Remember how Nene did a really amazing job during the Christmas show?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She managed to overcome what happened to her in the past and put on an incredible singing performance!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, each show they've done up until now seems to have involved overcoming some kind of hurdle.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Being reminded of what they've achieved may give them a nice boost of confidence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! Nice idea, Miku♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But which one? They've done so many♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: “A Pianist Named Thorpe” or “The Happy Phoenix” seem like good options.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those involved Tsukasa making rather remarkable strides as an actor.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm. Still, which do we choose?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it's too hard to pick just one!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we do all of them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: As much as I'm sure we'd all like to, I don't think we'll have enough time to prepare...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
I'm actually not sure if I'll be able to remember all of my lines.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means we should probably just pick one and focus all our attention on it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But which one? They've done so many♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: Luka, Len & Rin
rows.Line: Hmmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tsukasa and the others are gonna leave Phoenix Wonderland to do shows in all sorts of different places, right...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Their goal is to improve their skills by meeting new people and performing in new places.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I'm sure they're going to achieve some spectacular results!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After all, they've already succeeded in putting on a show that involved the entire cast of Phoenix Wonderland♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah, for the night show!
That was so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really was! And it was great that we got to join in on the fun.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I know, right☆
I was so moved by Shao and Miles's story that...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wait a second!!!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why?! What's wrong?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've been forgetting about one of their most important shows! The one about Shao and Miles!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was about making people who've lost hope smile again with magic!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And I know that smiles and laughter mean absolutely everything to them! Everything!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, Tsukasa wanted to become an actor because he wanted his little sister Saki to smile♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, right...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not only that, Emu's dream is to protect Phoenix Wonderland and fill it with even more smiles, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nene and Rui also want their shows to put smiles on the faces of the people who come see them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Miku's right.
Smiles and laughter do mean quite a lot to them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I wanna do that show and encourage them to keep making people smile and laugh.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It'll be our way of telling them to keep doing their best☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that sounds wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna do that show too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, let's go with Miku's suggestion.
The story of Shao and Miles!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright♪ Let's do our absolute best for Tsukasa and the others☆

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
